method: Finite paired component contours and unique linear strips on consecutive native latitude columns;minimum native-supported span where a boundary is censored. All three regional cohorts queried together under one cumulative ledger.
window_interpretation: ACC0–1000m,slope0–500m,coastal0–200m select original cores;they are not uniform thicknesses,depth caps,observation limits,bed or model/instrument boundaries. No surface gate added.
layer_metric_interpretation: Thickness is lower minus upper depth,not absolute lower depth,core depth,search window,transport decay scale,salinity/geostrophic reference or bathymetry.
minimum_span_interpretation: Conditional first-to-last contiguous native support under original piecewise-linear signed-component model,not physical current thickness bounds. Single-level zero is uninformative,not absence.
range_interpretation: Native-bracket sampling scenarios,not physical uncertainty,confidence intervals or annual envelopes.
identity_scope: Central Drake ACC component is not full circumpolar ACC/specific front/whole passage. DML slope westward reach is not whole slope system/coastal alias/Gunnerus branch/eastward undercurrent. Bellingshausen coastal component is not slope alias/full coast or an independently classified salinity layer. Original operator identity/window contexts retained without parent-depth inheritance or independent body classification.
axis_anchor_interpretation: 29original model axis proxies and19explicit null gaps retain original candidate diagnoses;no replacement core,date,branch,gate or source.
interpretation: Partial regional component geometry,not independently identified named-current axis,flow-normal width,whole-route depth,terrain clearance or physical water volume. No between-section physical interpolation or additive bodies.
